latestVersion.changelog: Major stability and feature update by Claude Opus: added PubMed abstracts, DOI deduplication, safer date handling, and robust error handling.

raw_record.summary: Assistance with writing literature reviews by searching for academic sources via Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref and PubMed APIs. Use when the user needs to find papers on a topic, get details for specific DOIs, or draft sections of a literature review with proper citations.
